data.text/markdown:
Sequence-Based Discovery and Prioritization of Novel AAV Capsids

Research Question

How does sequence similarity to known natural AAV isolates vary among MADCAP-discovered capsids, and can sequence-diversity metrics be used to identify candidates for further structural and experimental characterization?

data.text/markdown:
Identifying Novel and Known AAV Capsids

Capsid names beginning with "MC" represent capsids discovered through the MADCAP pipeline. The remaining capsids represent previously known natural AAV isolates. These groups are identified from their sequence names so that novel MADCAP capsids can be compared directly with known AAVs.

data.text/markdown:
Measuring Similarity to Known AAV Capsids

For each MADCAP capsid, sequence identity is compared against all previously known capsids in the dataset. Three summary measurements are calculated:
  • nearest known capsid
  • highest sequence identity to a known capsid
  • average sequence identity to all known capsids
Sequence divergence from the nearest known capsid is also calculated as 100 minus the maximum sequence identity.
